name: Link
purpose: Render finished native navigation as inline, standalone, or button-like content without changing its link semantics.
useWhen: The user moves to a route, URL, document, download, email address, or telephone destination.

avoidWhen.condition: The interaction changes current state without navigating.

composition: Provide a real href or compose a router-owned anchor, then choose a visual variant independently from navigation semantics.

rules.statement: Preserve anchor semantics and a real destination even when the link looks like a button.
Load styles.css or core.css plus link.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Replacing a destination with Button because the design is prominent.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Link and select the appropriate Brick variant.

validation: Test focus, Enter navigation, visited/external behavior when relevant, and contrast.
